name: JG_ZZ_VAT_UPG_STG
description: JG_ZZ_VAT_UPG_STG stores mapping information of Legal Entities, Ledgers, Operating Units, and Country Codes. The table is populated by the upgrade script, which extracts all Operating Units belonging to countries that use the EMEA VAT solution, and identifies the corresponding Ledgers, GRE/LEs, and country codes.

columns.name: VAT_HEADER_ID
columns.description: VAT header identifier. System generated key column

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Legal entity identifier associated with ORGANIZATION_ID

columns.name: LOCATION_ID
columns.description: Location identifier for the combination of ORGANIZATION_ID and COUNTRY_CODE

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.description: Party identifier for a legal entity

columns.name: TAX_REGISTRATION_NUMBER
columns.description: Tax registration number for a legal entity

columns.name: TAX_CALENDER
columns.description: Tax calendar; dependent on the country and ledger

columns.name: REPORT_SEQUENCE_FLAG
columns.description: Report sequence flag for ECE countries

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
